issues.display_title: Issue #205: Fix: False update notification popup on latest version (v1.1.10)
issues.main_description_html:
Problem Summary

Users already running the latest version of the app (v1.1.10) still continuously receive an update notification popup asking them to update to v1.1.10.

This causes confusion because the currently running version and the recommended update version are identical.

Root Cause

The update checking mechanism compares the latest version from the server (1.1.10) with the local version configured in the app. However, the local configuration (src/utils/config.ts) was still hardcoded to an older version (1.1.4), causing the version comparison check (1.1.10 > 1.1.4) to falsely assume a new update is available.

Solution & Changes

  • Automatic Version Sync: Updated src/utils/config.ts to dynamically retrieve appVersion from package.json (packageJson.version).
  • Accurate Update Checking: The version comparison now compares against the real active version (1.1.10), preventing the update popup from appearing when already on the latest version.

Verification

  • Confirmed config.appVersion matches package.json (1.1.10).
  • Verified update check does not trigger false update notifications when on 1.1.10.
  • All unit tests and typecheck pass (pnpm typecheck, pnpm test).

🚀 Research & Development Overview: High-Performance 360° Fisheye Stitcher

  • Core Engine Repository: GoThruMedia/fisheye-stitch (master branch)
  • Related Implementation Issues: #215 (Manual Crop Tool & Inspector)

This issue documents the full research, architecture design, performance benchmarks, and implementation milestones completed for the fisheye-stitch engine and its integration into GoThru Photo Studio Tauri.

1. 📌 Objective & Core Problem

The goal of this research is to build a fast, high-quality, and robust 360° equirectangular stitching pipeline that matches or exceeds industry standards (such as PTGui), while providing seamless integration as a native backend engine in Tauri.

Key Bottlenecks Identified in Legacy Pipeline:

  1. Low-Texture Feature Matching Failure: Traditional feature matchers (cpfind / SIFT) frequently fail on plain walls, ceilings, and indoor scenes, resulting in misalignment or failed stitches.
  2. Slow Blending Performance: CPU-bound enblend on large 8K/12K canvases takes 25–60+ seconds, representing over 80% of total stitching time.
  3. Circular Fisheye Artifacts: Circular fisheye shots (e.g. 8mm on Full Frame sensors) leave black circular borders that corrupt nona warping and exposure models if uncropped.
  4. Resolution & Format Flexibility: Need for seamless output format support (JPEG, PNG, TIFF) and standard resolution presets (4K, 8K, 12K).

2. 🏗️ Architecture & Pipeline Flow

The engine drives an optimized 8-step pipeline with multi-engine modularity:

[1/8] Generating Project (pto_gen + pto_var)
  │
[2/8] Finding Control Points
  ├── Matcher A: Hugin cpfind (Fast multi-threaded CPU SIFT)
  └── Matcher B: SuperPoint + LightGlue AI (GPU/CUDA Accelerated)
  │
[3/8] Cleaning Control Points (cpclean + geometric verification)
  │
[4/8] Optimizing Geometry & Photometry (autooptimiser)
  │
[5/8] Canvas Setup & Resolution Presets (pano_modify)
  │
[6/8] Image Remapping / Warping (nona)
  │
[7/8] Multi-Band Panorama Blending
  ├── Blender A: Multiblend SIMD CPU (Fastest: ~1.0s - 3.9s)
  ├── Blender B: GPU Multi-Band PyTorch CUDA (~3.0s - 9.0s)
  └── Blender C: Enblend CPU (Standard Reference Fallback)
  │
[8/8] Final Format Encoding (Direct TIFF, JPEG q1-100, or PNG)

3. 🛠️ Major Features & Innovations Implemented

A. 🧠 Deep Learning Feature Matching: SuperPoint + LightGlue (--matcher lightglue)

  • Location: models/lightglue_matcher.py in GoThruMedia/fisheye-stitch
  • Capabilities:
    • AI keypoint extraction and transformer-based matching on challenging indoor scenes.
    • Scale-aware resizing (1600px default) for sub-second inference and low VRAM footprint (~750 MB).
    • EXIF orientation mapping & coordinate un-rotation back to native image grid.
    • Generates clean, top-K confidence-ranked Hugin .pto control points.
  • CLI Options: --matcher lightglue, --lightglue-device <auto|cuda|cpu|mps>, --lightglue-max-points <int>.

B. ⚡ High-Speed Blending Engines (--blender)

  1. Multiblend (--blender multiblend) — Recommended for Maximum Speed:
    • Multi-threaded SIMD CPU multi-band blending using models/multiblend.exe.
    • Incorporates --wideblend -w to ensure seamless 360° horizontal wrap around the $0^\circ \leftrightarrow 360^\circ$ seam.
    • Slashes blend time on 8K panoramas from ~24.0s down to ~1.0s – 3.9s.
  2. GPU Multi-Band Blender (--blender gpu):
    • PyTorch CUDA multiresolution Laplacian & Gaussian pyramid blending via models/gpu_blender.py.
    • Produces clean 2:1 pure equirectangular output in ~3.0s – 9.0s.
  3. Enblend (--blender enblend):
    • Retained as 100% backward-compatible reference standard.

C. 📐 Resolution Presets & Output Format Options (--size, --format)

  • Resolution Presets (--size):
    • 4k: 4096 × 2048 px
    • 8k: 8192 × 4096 px
    • 12k: 12000 × 6000 px
    • auto: Native optimal resolution based on camera sensor pixels.
  • Output Formats (--format / --extension):
    • tiff (tif): Lossless, zero re-encode overhead ([8/8] completes in 0.03s).
    • jpeg (jpg): Web/VR ready with quality control (--quality 1-100).
    • png: Lossless compressed output.

D. ⭕ Circular Fisheye Auto & Manual Cropping (--auto-crop, --crop)

  • Auto-Detection (--auto-crop): Scans luminance thresholding to isolate circular image boundaries while ignoring standard full-frame frames.
  • Manual Precision Crop (--crop <left,right,top,bottom>): Explicit pixel rectangle cropping.

E. 🎨 Visual Development Tools (tools/)

  1. tools/crop-tool.html:
    • Standalone interactive HTML5/Canvas tool for visual circle inspection, auto-detection preview, interactive drag handles, pixel stepper, dark outer mask preview, and 1-click CLI flag copying.
  2. tools/mark-points.html:
    • Interactive visual tool with magnifier for manual control point marking on textureless surfaces.

F. 📦 Portable Distribution & Build Automation (build.rs)

  • Automated build.rs script copies models/ (all tools, DLLs, and scripts) directly into target/{debug,release}/models/ on every cargo build.
  • Clean separation:
    • models/: 100% runtime engine dependencies.
    • tools/: Developer utilities and test scripts.
  • Fully portable for Tauri sidecar packaging.

4. 📊 Performance Benchmark Summary (8K Canvas: 8192 × 4096)

Stage / Component Traditional Hugin New Optimized Engine Speedup
Control Point Matching 10.0s – 25.0s (cpfind CPU) 1.2s – 4.5s (LightGlue GPU) ~3x – 6x
Panorama Blending 24.0s – 57.0s (enblend CPU) 1.0s – 3.9s (multiblend SIMD) ~10x – 15x
TIFF / JPEG Conversion 15.0s – 25.0s 0.03s (TIFF) / ~2.5s (JPG) Instant / 6x
Total Stitch Time (8K) ~50s – 90s ~6.5s – 12.0s 🚀 ~6x – 8x Faster

5. 💻 CLI Usage Quick Reference

# 1. Ultra-fast production mode (LightGlue + Multiblend 8K)
fisheye-stitch.exe --input "./photos" --matcher lightglue --blender multiblend --size 8k --output "./panorama.jpg"

# 2. Circular fisheye with auto-crop
fisheye-stitch.exe --input "xample/3" --auto-crop --matcher lightglue --blender multiblend --size 8k --output "./result.jpg"

# 3. Explicit manual crop from crop-tool.html
fisheye-stitch.exe --input "xample/3" --crop 1166,5554,46,4434 --matcher lightglue --blender multiblend --size 8k

6. ✅ Verification & Status

  • Unit Tests: 65 unit tests covering configuration, pipeline discovery, rotation solvers, and format encoders (100% passing).
  • Repository Branch: Merged into master on GoThruMedia/fisheye-stitch.
  • Ready for Tauri Sidecar Update: The compiled fisheye-stitch.exe and models/ directory are ready to be integrated into gothru-photo-studio-tauri.

issues.display_title: Issue #215: feat(stitching): Manual Fisheye Circle Crop Tool & Visual Inspector
issues.main_description_html:
🎯 Feature Implementation: Manual Fisheye Circle Crop Tool & Visual Inspector

  • Repository: GoThruMedia/fisheye-stitch (master branch)
  • Parent Research Issue: #199

1. 📌 Background & Motivation

Certain circular fisheye camera rigs (such as an 8mm circular fisheye lens mounted on a 35mm full-frame sensor, e.g. Canon EOS R in xample/3) project a circular image inside the rectangular sensor frame, leaving thick black borders around the circle.

Without an explicit crop:

  • The black border is treated as valid image data by nona, warping black streaks across the panorama zenith and nadir.
  • The photometric optimizer samples the black pixels, severely skewing exposure and color balance across the entire 360° panorama.

To give developers and photographers total control when automatic circle detection requires fine-tuning, a complete Manual Crop System and Visual Inspector Tool have been developed in GoThruMedia/fisheye-stitch.

2. 🛠️ Implementation Breakdown

A. CLI Engine Integration (fisheye-stitch.exe)

  • Flag: --crop <left,right,top,bottom> (pixel coordinates in source image space).
  • CLI Validation: Added parse_crop in src/config.rs ensuring $right > left$ and $bottom > top$, with clear error messages on invalid input.
  • Pipeline Execution: Passes -c <left,right,top,bottom> directly to pto_gen. During nona remapping, only the valid image circle within the specified bounds is transformed, eliminating black borders.
  • Mutual Exclusivity: Properly configured in clap to conflict with --auto-crop so conflicting flags are rejected cleanly.

B. Standalone Interactive Visual Tool (tools/crop-tool.html)

A zero-dependency, single-file HTML5/Canvas tool in the fisheye-stitch repo designed for visual inspection and pixel-perfect cropping in any browser:

  • Interactive Canvas Viewport:
    • High-DPI pan & zoom (scroll wheel zoom, middle-click / space drag to pan, fit-to-window 0, 1:1 native 1).
    • Live cursor coordinate readout ($X, Y$) and image dimension inspection.
  • Client-Side Auto-Detect:
    • One-click "Auto-Detect Circle" button implementing the exact luminance thresholding algorithm (DARK = 16, bounding box scanning) as the Rust CLI.
  • Visual Guides & Masking:
    • Dark Outer Mask: Semi-transparent dark curtain outside the circle crop bounds (adjustable opacity 0–95%) to clearly preview preserved vs cut-off areas.
    • Interactive Transform Handles: Center handle to reposition the circle, and perimeter handles (Top, Bottom, Left, Right) to resize the radius directly on the canvas.
    • Center Crosshair: Visual alignment guide to verify optical symmetry.
  • Pixel-Precision Fine Tuning:
    • Numeric input fields for Left, Right, Top, Bottom, Center X, Center Y, Radius, and Diameter.
    • Keyboard arrow support (Arrow = ±1px, Shift + Arrow = ±10px).
  • 1-Click Export Options:
    • Copy --crop: Copies --crop <left,right,top,bottom> ready for CLI.
    • Copy Full Command: Copies full executable command line.
    • Copy JSON: Exports crop metadata in JSON format.

3. 🧪 Verification & Real-World Testing

  • Test Dataset: xample/3 (Canon EOS R, 8.0mm Fisheye, $6720 \times 4480$ px).
  • Detected & Fine-Tuned Coordinates: --crop 1166,5554,46,4434 (Diameter: 4388px).
  • Execution Command: 
    fisheye-stitch.exe --input "xample/3" --crop 1166,5554,46,4434 --matcher lightglue --blender multiblend --size 8k --output "result.jpg"
  • Result: Output panorama rendered cleanly with zero black border streaks and perfect exposure balance.

4. 📁 Project Structure & Build Integration

  • tools/crop-tool.html: Standalone visual development tool.
  • models/: Consolidates 100% of runtime engine binaries and scripts (multiblend.exe, lightglue_matcher.py, gpu_blender.py, Hugin tools & DLLs).
  • build.rs: Automated Cargo build script that automatically packages models/ into target/release/models/ during compilation.

5. ✅ Deliverables & Acceptance Checklist

  • CLI flag --crop <left,right,top,bottom> implemented and covered by unit tests.
  • Interactive tool tools/crop-tool.html created and documented.
  • Documentation updated in README.md and USAGE.md.
  • 65/65 unit tests passing.
  • Branch merged to master in GoThruMedia/fisheye-stitch.

Overview

Following a recent review, the auto-update process is not working as expected. Research and investigation are required to identify the root cause for the latest version (v1.1.10).

Scope of Work / Action Items

  • Verify GitHub Releases: Check latest release version tags (v1.1.10), uploaded binaries, and update manifest metadata on GitHub.
  • Verify Database: Check the latest version records (v1.1.10) and queries in the database.
  • Inspect Code: Audit auto-update logic, backend commands/IPC channels, and updater event handlers.

Expected Outcome

  • Root cause identified and documented for version 1.1.10.
  • Recommended fix or solution proposed to restore auto-update functionality.

issues.display_title: Issue #201: Preserve Active Folder Path When Navigating from Edit Tool to Preview Mode
issues.main_description_html:
DEMO FROM DEVELOPER

Screen.Recording.2026-09-04.at.10.44.11.mov

Description

When a user switches from the Edit Tool to Preview mode in GoThru Photo Studio, the application loses the current folder context and does not return the user to the directory they were previously working in.

Acceptance Criteria:

  1. Store and persist the active folder directory path/ID in the app state when launching or exiting the Edit Tool.
  2. Ensure triggering the Preview view automatically loads and displays files within the matching active folder location.
  3. Verify seamless two-way navigation state retention when toggling between Edit and Preview modes.
